name: iran-icmp-2026-10
description: Packet-level Iranian ICMP behaviours from one datacenter-route measurement (#676). Thresholds are lab parameters; the report says so. Only meaningful in the netns lab.

rules.note: echo requests Iran to abroad dropped, abroad to Iran fine; other ICMP types pass.
payloads above about 640 B dropped (8-byte ICMP header included in min_len).
sustained volume triggers a block of the pair for a while. Real trigger is about 30 MB/s for a few seconds; the lab uses packets per second and a short block. Parameters, not truths.
abroad-to-Iran direction capped at about 50-55k ICMP pps. Absolute rate depends on the host, so the lab parameter is much lower.
